mapper.select: select (select count(id) from owners) as numberOfOwners, (select count(id) from pets) as numberOfPets, (select count(id) from boarding_records where status = 'BOARDING') as numberOfBoardingStatus, (select COALESCE(sum(total_fee), 0) from boarding_records) as sumOfRevenue, (select count(id) from care_notes ) as numberOfNotes ;
select pet_id, count(id) as record_count from boarding_records group by pet_id order by record_count desc limit 1;

SELECT YEAR(check_in_date) AS nam , QUARTER(check_in_date) AS quy , SUM(total_fee) AS tong_doanh_thu FROM boarding_records
status = 'RETURNED'
AND YEAR(check_in_date) = #{year}
AND QUARTER(check_in_date) = #{quarter}
GROUP BY YEAR(check_in_date)
, QUARTER(check_in_date)
ORDER BY nam DESC
, quy DESC
